label: try T58, a labelled in-sample diagnostic, never an adoption result: M1 (with R1, R2 and g_mom's factors, the entry's form) with its Feng step at 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 times, try T45's placebo direction at 2, 3, 4 and 5 times and try T45's there-and-back arms from 3, 4 and 5 times back to twice the step, on the chamber cut's pooled truth, library 3's and library 2's, the reference thinned to two thirds and a half (try T54's draws) and the whole cut; the result can only go to the team captain, it sets no step, and no outcome is evidence on Task 1's read depth, which stays closed
statements: Statement 1, per world and multiple k of 3, 4 and 5, each paired by seed with its mean, seeds ahead, per-seed range and its label by try T46's single-task test: the step's increment R_k = x_k - x_2; the placebo's increment P_k = p_k - p_2; the specific increment S_k = R_k - P_k.

Statement 2, per world and k, the same way: V_k = x_kb2 - x_2, x_k's extra zeroing and redraw at about twice the step's expected counts (a reading of the closed depth lever, never a reason to add redraw or sparsity), and N_k = x_k - x_kb2, the step's expected change at about x_k's zero pattern.

Statement 3, on the six readings (k = 3 and 4 in pooled, whole and lib3), gated as try T45's statements are on its (h): 'the step's gain beyond twice its size is not in all six readings' if any of the six readings of R_k is level or behind, naming each with R_k's and P_k's means and, where S_k reads ahead there, 'the placebo loses more' (the other readings may still gain); otherwise 'the gain beyond twice the step needs Feng's own genes' if S_3 and S_4 read ahead by try T46's test in all six and P_3 and P_4 in none, quoting each of the six with R_k's and P_k's means ('not ahead' includes a placebo gain below 0.3 points); 'a placebo gains as well; Feng's direction more' if S_3 and S_4 read ahead in all six and P_k is ahead in any, naming each such reading with R_k's and P_k's means; otherwise 'not shown', naming each of the six where S_k is level or behind. The three that read S_k carry 'one placebo permutation, try T45's first' in the outcome. Beside the outcome, deciding nothing: whether S_3 and S_4 read ahead in all six (decision log 2026-11-18 (c)'s condition, with the six labels), each of the six readings' R_k, P_k and S_k means and seeds ahead, and the placebo arms' applied sizes more than 10% from Feng's.
choices: The there-and-back arms call perm_read.there_and_back with the fraction of twice the step (m1_r_gmom_x2's) and the multiplier k/2: its first edit is then (2 x 0.2) x (k/2), the same float as the x_k arm's 0.2 x k (both are the one rounding of the exact product), and its second edit (1 - k/2) x (2 x 0.2) the same float as (2 - k) x 0.2; no copy of try T45's code.

The three there-and-back arms share try T45's second stream (index perm_read.SECOND_STREAM after the build seed), as try T45's two there-and-back arms do (each is its own build and uses it once); the brief names that code's own stream, so no new stream index is drawn.
A placebo or there-and-back arm's twin is the step arm of its first fraction (p_k's and x_kb2's twin is x_k): an idle permutation or an idle second edit scores exactly as x_k.
The placebo record is checked against try T45's committed m1_r_gmom_p1 and m1_r_gmom_p2 records in both of try T45's files; a missing try T45 file voids.

S_k is the paired per-seed difference (x_k - x_2) - (p_k - p_2), tested as try T45's (a) is (the increments as arms, perm_read._arm_difference, with try T50's comparison); R_k, P_k, V_k and N_k are try T50's comparison of the two arms.

Statement 3 names each of the six readings that is not ahead, with its label ('level' or 'behind'); the gate on R_k and the split on P_k follow try T45's statements ((h) gates; (b) passing gives 'a placebo gains as well').

Each placebo arm's record is the direction sha256 of the object its own build received, collected per seed and folded by perm_read.placebo_record; the read also voids a record equal to Feng's in any group (try T45's condition).

A placebo arm p_k (k = 3, 4, 5) scoring exactly as p_2 on every seed of a world voids (an idle fraction); the prediction sha256 is not compared across worlds, because the board's cell count follows each world's truth.
The whole cut's truth is loaded as tries T44 and T45 load it (harness.filter_target when the task has a target filter, otherwise the released target on the panel); its file records truth 'whole'.
The thinned worlds' checks are try T57's statement of try T54's (part_range_read._thinning_reasons).
The run's --out folder for the command lines is t58_ctl_range.
limits: A placebo that gains as much as the step says the gain goes with factors of this size profile or with redrawn counts, not that Feng's direction is wrong.
Where R_k is negative (the step has turned) a positive S_k only says the placebo falls faster.
A there-and-back arm redraws more than either end.
Each difference is taken inside one world.
A thinned reference is one draw and is not a deeper truth.
Nothing here says how deep any hidden truth is, and no statement may be used with a figure for it.
x_kb2 returns to x_2's expected counts approximately (exactly only for a depth constant taken from expectations) and keeps x_k's zeroing.

V_k reads x_k's extra zeroing and redraw at twice the step's expected counts; it is a reading of the closed depth lever and never a reason to add redraw or sparsity; N_k compares x_k with an arm that shares its zeros, not with x_2.
The six readings of statement 3 are two cuts (chamber, whole); pooled and lib3 share the reference, the builds and part of the truth, and S_3 and S_4 share x_2 and p_2.
Try T46's placebo (random permutation on stream 46) is not run here; only try T45's first within-bin permutation, and not its second (q1, q2).

Decision log 2026-11-18 (c) names try T46's placebo and reads S_3 and S_4 alone; this read runs try T45's first within-bin permutation in its place, gates on R_k and splits on P_k. The log's own condition (S_3 and S_4 ahead in all six readings) is reported beside the outcome and decides nothing: with R_k level and a placebo that loses as k grows it holds whether or not the step gains.

P_k 'not ahead' by try T46's test includes a placebo that gains up to 0.3 points on the mean, or more on fewer than 8 of 10 seeds; the outcome that the gain needs Feng's own genes quotes each of the six readings' R_k and P_k means.
An increment near 0.3 points gives an outcome that noise decides between the four; each of the six readings' R_k, P_k and S_k means and seeds ahead are printed beside the outcome.

The placebo's applied size on the non-held genes can differ from Feng's (the permutation moves values onto and off the held genes, more as k grows); a larger placebo loses more and raises S_k. Groups more than 10% from Feng's are flagged beside statement 3 (perm_read.size_flags); the flag decides nothing.
